description: This file defines the SugarFieldFullname class which extends SugarFieldBase. It handles display and sanitization logic for full name fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including methods for rendering detail views and parsing full names during import.

classes.name: SugarFieldFullname
classes.description: Class handling full name field rendering and import sanitization in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and fetches the template for displaying the full name in detail view.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and splits the full name during import to populate first and last name fields, respecting locale-specific name formats.
